newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria PM says accepts currency board plan.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria PM says accepts currency board plan.

text.p: Bulgaria's Prime Minister Zhan Videnov said on Monday the government and the central bank accepted the currency board plan proposed by the IMF to stabilise the crumbling financial system.

"The government together with the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) plan to inform their partners, the International Monetary Fund, that we have accepted the currency board idea," Videnov told a news conference.
